english.note: Use this when someone causes A to dislike or turn against B, rather than when the issue is physical poisoning.

exampleSentences.english: His constant bad-mouthing of Ming can poison my feelings toward him.
exampleSentences.traditional: 佢成日講阿明壞話，搞到我憎阿明。
